Entries.Title: TV5
Entries.Description: TV5 is a major Philippine television network offering a mix of local and international programming, including news, entertainment, and sports.

Entries.Title: A2Z (ABS-CBN)
Entries.Description: A2Z is a Philippine free-to-air blocktime broadcast television network based in Quezon City, with its studios located in Ortigas Center, Pasig. It serves as a flagship property of ZOE Broadcasting Network, the broadcast media arm of Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide, in partnership with ABS-CBN Corporation as its main content provider through a blocktime agreement.

Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Night Carnage
Entries.Description: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

Entries.Title: The Pickup
Entries.Description: A routine cash pickup takes a wild turn when mismatched armored truck drivers Russell and Travis are ambushed by ruthless criminals led by savvy mastermind Zoe.

Entries.Title: Creation of the Gods II: Demon Force
Entries.Description: Taishi Wen Zhong led the army of Shang Dynasty including Deng Chanyu and four generals of the Mo Family to Xiqi. With the help of Kunlun immortals such as Jiang Ziya, Ji Fa led the army and civilians of Xiqi to defend their homeland.

Entries.Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Entries.Description: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — Infinity Castle
Entries.Description: As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.  The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons' stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha 2
Entries.Description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

Entries.Title: KPop Demon Hunters
Entries.Description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys 2
Entries.Description: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon
Entries.Description: In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he decides to pursue his abandoned dream of joining the Force, when he suddenly transforms into the powerful "Kaiju No. 8." An action-packed recap of the first season of Kaiju No. 8 and a new original episode, Hoshina's Day Off.

Entries.Title: Mercy for None
Entries.Description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After Nam Gi-seok's mysterious death, Nam Gi-jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After tracking down Gi-seok's hit, Gi-jun discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun-mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi-jun himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi-seok's hit. After Jun-mo attacks his friends, Gi-jun goes head-to-head with Jun-mo's army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeong-do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum-son seizes power, Gi-jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum-son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi-jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

Entries.Title: The Winning Try
Entries.Description: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Incognito
Entries.Description: In search of redemption, a crew of misfits joins a private military company on a series of deadly missions against the criminal underworld.

Episodes.Title: Job Order
Episodes.Description: A bloody incident drives an army general to enlist the help of the only person who can prevent an impending diplomatic crisis in the country.

Episodes.Title: Arrival
Episodes.Description: Greg, the Contractor, gathers a team of skilled individuals for an important job. The team springs into action and begins their dangerous assignment.

Episodes.Title: Common Ground
Episodes.Description: Greg's team wastes no time in accomplishing their dangerous plan after receiving a 3-day ultimatum from the kidnapper of the ambassador's daughter.

Episodes.Title: Complication
Episodes.Description: Miguel fights the temptation in the Escalera mansion. Andres discovers a grim situation in the island. Heart senses something awkward with the guests.

Episodes.Title: Purely Business
Episodes.Description: After his informant's death, Greg immediately plans to abduct Donato. Andres defies his leader and rescues the victims of human trafficking.

Episodes.Title: Shaken
Episodes.Description: The mission fails when JB, Miguel, and Andres fall victim to a trap intended for the target. The team races against time to accomplish their job.

Episodes.Title: Fetch
Episodes.Description: The team infiltrates the enemy territory to get their target. But the Escalera's security gets alerted while the team heads out to their exit point.

Episodes.Title: Run!
Episodes.Description: An intense encounter occurs when the Escalera cousins attempt to rescue Donato. As they feel a definite victory, the team risks everything they have.

Episodes.Title: Payment
Episodes.Description: After receiving payment for their services, Andres, Tomas, Max, and JB will face their personal problems as they go back to their respective lives.

Episodes.Title: Lights Out
Episodes.Description: The team faces a major setback due to Donato's actions. As a result, the Contractor gives the team a new mission that they cannot refuse.

Episodes.Title: Territory
Episodes.Description: Timor appoints Clover to lead the organization in his absense. With Greg's promise, JB and the team reflects on the reasons of their dismissal.

Episodes.Title: Trouble
Episodes.Description: Having new identities, the team flies to Cerdova for their new mission. Despite Greg's orders to avoid getting attention, trouble seems to find them.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: Andres sets out on a personal mission, increasing JB's suspicion. JB and Max decide to keep an eye on Andres, but this leads them to someone else.

Episodes.Title: Face to Face
Episodes.Description: Trying to get an intel on their target, Tomas runs into someone suspicious. Andres puts on an act to gain the trust of Timor's associate.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: Finding an opportunity, KB and Andres immediately takes into action that goes against Greg's plan. This leads the team to dangerous consequences.

Episodes.Title: Cerdova
Episodes.Description: After retrieving Miguel and Tomas, Greg swoops in to rescue Max, JB and Andres from the crossfire. Together, they must make a daring escape from Cerdova.

Episodes.Title: Motive
Episodes.Description: The team stays at the hideout while awaiting further orders, but Andres' emotions take over when he's face to face with the gang leader.

Episodes.Title: Bargain
Episodes.Description: After an outburst that injures their target, Greg talks to Andres about his temper. Timor uses the situation to his advantage.

Episodes.Title: Assault
Episodes.Description: Timor tries to find an ally within the Contractor's team, prompting JB, Andres and Max to reconcile. Masked figures attack the hideout.

Episodes.Title: Headshot
Episodes.Description: The team must protect their valuable asset as their hideout falls under siege. While on guard, JB receives a startling claim that rattles him.

Episodes.Title: Kings
Episodes.Description: Miguel lashes out at the team when they face the fallout from the attack on their hideout. Later, JB considers his next steps with his father in mind.

Episodes.Title: Corner
Episodes.Description: As the Escaleras conduct their illegal ring, Andres trails a lead to uncover their location. Elsewhere, Tomas' impulsive good deed backfires on him.

Episodes.Title: Drive
Episodes.Description: Andres prepares for a risky scheme against the Escaleras. As JB recruits Max to hack an encrypted file, a frustrated Gabriela confronts her father.

Episodes.Title: Underdogs
Episodes.Description: Andres' stakeout goes south, prompting him to regroup and seek help from JB. Meanwhile, Gabriela makes a crafty move to bail Tomas out of a jam.

Episodes.Title: Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: Facing a hurdle, JB contacts Max for help on Andres' scheme. Tomas works a side job for Gabriela while Miguel makes a desperate play for his son.

Episodes.Title: Ransack
Episodes.Description: When Andres launches his scheme against the Escaleras with his team, they fall into a trap. Tomas finally learns what he must retrieve for Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Unforgiven
Episodes.Description: Max struggles with a major tech issue while Gabriela finishes Tomas' mission. Elsewhere, Miguel gets into an altercation with Christine's new partner.

Episodes.Title: Hotel
Episodes.Description: While Andres makes necessary preparations before a violent showdown, a pleasant hotel faces serious trouble from a charismatic figure.

Episodes.Title: Detected
Episodes.Description: Greg accepts a contract from an old ally and briefs the team on their new mission: rescue a hotel from the grips of a shadowy leader named Rema Muñoz.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: The team deals with turmoil as they prepare for their mission. Meanwhile, workers and guests at the hotel scramble for safety from Muñoz's followers.

Episodes.Title: Detected
Episodes.Description: The team races to stop Muñoz's men before more hostages die, while the Escalera gang hunts for Clover's phone to track who stole the master list.

Episodes.Title: Back Up
Episodes.Description: Despite being cautious, Rema's group finds out about the team's operation. The mission gets complicated when an unexpected backup arrives.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Tomas works to help a pregnant woman, while JB attempts to to reunite a hostage with her husband. Police intervention at the hotel adds new challenges.

Episodes.Title: Together
Episodes.Description: Andres helps Tomas with a hostage, while Gabriela discovers a group of students who refuse to leave without their coach.

Episodes.Title: Delivery
Episodes.Description: Things heat up when the Escalera gang closes in on the location. Miguel guides Andres as the pregnant hostage goes into labor.

Episodes.Title: Devotion
Episodes.Description: Muñoz's subordinates attempt to jeopardize the mission, but help arrives in time. A life hangs in the balance as Miguel faces a harrowing dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Ring
Episodes.Description: Max enters the hotel to assist in the mission but soon realizes her ring is missing. As the team evacuates hostages, the Escalera gang makes their move.

Episodes.Title: Sinners
Episodes.Description: Muñoz's plan begins to collapse when a follower questions his actions. The cult leader initiates the countdown of the bombs around the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Half Truth
Episodes.Description: As the team rushes to free the remaining hostages, JB and Miguel work to defuse the bombs. Andres and Muñoz face off in a tense showdown.

Episodes.Title: Swords
Episodes.Description: Andres asks Max for the hard drive, promising to deal with the tracker. Greg reveals to Col. Locsin that he knows about Sen. Lacosta's deal with Muñoz.

Episodes.Title: Source
Episodes.Description: The Escaleras keep searching for the thief while Andres checks the master list for his brother. Greg gets a tip about what happened at the safe house.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: After receiving key intel, JB confronts his father about the intruders and his tattoo. Gabriela storms her dad's house to ask about Tomas.

Episodes.Title: No Escape
Episodes.Description: JB blocks Andres from talking to his father about the Escaleras. Meanwhile, Greg's new contract threatens to expose the safehouse siege.

Episodes.Title: Close to Home
Episodes.Description: Max panics after JB reveals Greg's new contract, especially with Andres out of reach — unaware that he's infiltrated Isabel Escalera's quarters.

Episodes.Title: Compadre
Episodes.Description: As the Escaleras meet at Isabel's to discuss the master list, JB and Andres clash over the hard drive. Miguel fears he's being followed.

Episodes.Title: Head
Episodes.Description: After Andres asks JB for more time with the hard drive, Greg discusses the new contract with him. Miguel tries to make amends with his family.

Episodes.Title: Lifeline
Episodes.Description: Time is running out for Andres as Greg orders the team to find Isabel. He enters a high-stakes negotiation with the Escalera matriarch.

Episodes.Title: The Killing List
Episodes.Description: A string of high-profile assassinations sparks tension within the Escalera family. Isabel blackmails Andres to get the hard drive back.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Protector
Episodes.Description: The team zeroes in on Diamond and the gang, but as assailants arrive on the scene, Andres must make a confession. JB rushes to protect his father.

Episodes.Title: Departure
Episodes.Description: Andres tries to evade the mystery attackers and get Isabel to safety. JB defends his father while the rest of the team continues the mission.

Episodes.Title: Mad Man
Episodes.Description: While Andres helps Isabel escape, she entrusts him with a message. Max reveals the truth about the hard drive to Greg.

Episodes.Title: Face the Music
Episodes.Description: After the mission ends, Greg and JB have a heart-to-heart about the hard drive and Andres. Meanwhile, masked men abduct Miguel.

Episodes.Title: Crackdown
Episodes.Description: Greg goes through Andres' file, while Gabriela confronts her father after he sells a beloved house. JB vows to take down the Elcano organization.

Episodes.Title: No Surrender
Episodes.Description: Max returns her fiance's ring to his mother, leading to a heartfelt conversation. Andres faces the team after the fallout of their last mission.

Episodes.Title: Brand New Day
Episodes.Description: Greg takes on a contract to take down Sameo Patel, a drug trafficker with suspicious ties. Andres considers buying back his family's land.

Episodes.Title: Mountain
Episodes.Description: A bad investment forces Tomas' godfather into hiding. Miguel tightens security around Christine and his son. JB leads the team into their mission.

Episodes.Title: Tropic Storm
Episodes.Description: While the team camps near a village, Miguel sees Sameo's subordinates heading for their campsite. Greg learns the truth about his friend.

Episodes.Title: Passage
Episodes.Description: Andres send guards to protect his family, but his grandmother is weary. Meanwhile, a storm arrives as the team heads to Sameo's stronghold.

Episodes.Title: Storage
Episodes.Description: The team pushes to complete the mission in heavy rain and Greg talks to Claire — his friend's wife — about what happened to her husband.

Episodes.Title: Loot
Episodes.Description: After clearing the hideout, the team splits up on route to the exit point. But a young member of Sameo's gang soon warns the others.

Episodes.Title: Desperados
Episodes.Description: On the way out of Mt. Talimba, Andres and Miguel discuss their financial needs while Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Boy
Episodes.Description: Andres and Miguel try to make a daring rescue. Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Money Matters
Episodes.Description: Andres wrestles with guilt over leaving the girl behind, while Tomas and JB struggle with the long journey and reflect on the past.

Episodes.Title: Intentions
Episodes.Description: A villager sees Andres and Miguel and seeks medical assistance. Meanwhile, Rita finds her brother, but he won't leave until he finds the intruders.

Episodes.Title: Gray Area
Episodes.Description: JB and Timas hide from Sameo's gang, while a hiker's scream briefly pulls Gabriela and Max away from their bags of money.

Episodes.Title: Cash Flow
Episodes.Description: As Andres and Miguel exchange fire with Emer, JB and Tomas escape from their assailants. Meanwhile, Max and Gabriela discover a devious trick.

Episodes.Title: Payback
Episodes.Description: While searching for the two hikers, Max and Gabriela face off against Benjie and his men. Andres assists a wounded Miguel.

Episodes.Title: All for the Family
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother confronts him about the money, while Gabriela gives her dad part of the payment for the old house, sparking an emotional talk.

Episodes.Title: Secret Contact
Episodes.Description: As Miguel and Christine talk about their son's future, Max gives back an orphanage and Greg unexpectedly turns down a contract.

Episodes.Title: Checking In
Episodes.Description: Gabriela has Tomas spy on her father's mistress. Meanwhile, Greg mulls over Isabel's last words as Andres hunts for a lead on his brother.

Episodes.Title: Option
Episodes.Description: Unable to reach Miguel, Greg briefs the team without him on their next mission: to capture assasssin Kenji Lee and find out who hired him.

Episodes.Title: Kaigen
Episodes.Description: With his father's condition worsening under custody, JB grows more determined to free him as the team gets ready to go to Kaigen in pursuit of Kenji.

Episodes.Title: Snowfall
Episodes.Description: While the team adjusts to the cold, they realize they're not the only ones hunting Kenji. With his family in peril, Miguel seeks help from Andres.

Episodes.Title: Bad Weather
Episodes.Description: As Greg reunites with and old friend, Max gets an important phone call while Gabriela decides to split from Tomas to survey the area in peace.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Storm
Episodes.Description: While looking for Gabriela, the team shifts focus when Andres spots Kenji. Back in the Philippines, Miguel shakes off his family's stalkers.

Episodes.Title: Frozen
Episodes.Description: Greg talks to a despondent Andres after the team hits a snag in the mission. Tomas opens up about his brother, while Max's news to gives hope to JB.

Episodes.Title: Snow Drift
Episodes.Description: As Max talks to Andres about loss and moving on, JB reflects on his last conversation with his father. Meanwhile, Miguel prepares for a showdown.

Episodes.Title: Slippery Slope
Episodes.Description: JB trails Kenji on a daring snowmobile chase as the rest of the team closes in. But things get complicated when the local mafia joins the hunt.

Episodes.Title: Blood on the Snow
Episodes.Description: To find Kenji, Max uses city cameras and tracks him down. Andres' grandmother goes to the agency to confirm the news about Jun.

Episodes.Title: Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Unable to move due to his condition, JB helplessly watches as Tomas fends off the Rai Jins alone. Meanwhile, Miguel continues his onslaught.

Episodes.Title: Departures
Episodes.Description: Rattled by Kenji's words, the team questions whether they should complete the contract or not. Greg makes a call to determine their course of action.

Episodes.Title: Traitors
Episodes.Description: As Andres reunites with his family, he and his grandmother discuss their suspicions about Jun. Elsewhere, Max voices concerns about JB's father's case.

Episodes.Title: Enduring Love
Episodes.Description: After the Kaigen mission, the team reunites for another get-together with Miguel. Later, Andres' grandmother urges him to move on from his search.

Episodes.Title: One Step Closer
Episodes.Description: JB turns into a violent as he pursues the man who conned him. Tomas goes on his first date with Agnes, while Gab confronts Shari at a yoga class.

Episodes.Title: Love and Drugs
Episodes.Description: A meeting with a young man raises new suspicions for Andres. As Gabriela breaks down over her mother's death, her father issues an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Bad Ideas
Episodes.Description: Gabriela struggles to reclaim her mother's resthouse, but Tomas has an idea. JB and Max continue plotting against the El Cano group.

Episodes.Title: Contractfully Yours
Episodes.Description: JB and Max get a possible lead on the El Cano organization. Tomas tells Ninong about his deal with Gabriela, while Gab speaks to her father.

Episodes.Title: Brother
Episodes.Description: While Greg searches for Raven, he remembers the mission that cost him his team their lives. Gabriela's father confronts Tomas, questioning his intentions.

Episodes.Title: Promises to Keep
Episodes.Description: After Dexter's meet-up with Manuel, JB and Max tail the target's car. Gabriela and Tomas move forward with their plan under her father's watchful eye.

Episodes.Title: Suspicions
Episodes.Description: As a celebration unfolds in Andres' home, Gabriela and Tomas endure an awkward dinner with her father and Ninong as they try not to blow their cover.

Episodes.Title: Collision Course
Episodes.Description: Unfazed by Diego's odd behavior, Andres talks to his grandmother about reclaiming their land. The next day, Greg briefs the team on their new mission.

Episodes.Title: At All Costs
Episodes.Description: Seeking to trail Diego, JB and Greg keep watch on Andres, while Max and Miguel comb through an event's guest list for suspicious names.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: As Andres confronts Diego about whether he's been avoiding him, Gabriela grows emotional over an unexpected gift from her father.

Episodes.Title: Meet Up
Episodes.Description: After clashing with Greg, Andres cools off with JB's help as the three reach a compromise on the mission. Meanwhile, Tomas runs into and old classmate.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: When the target leaves after meeting Andres, Greg and JB follow him to his base. Elsewhere, Gabriela presses Tomas about a woman he was seen with.

Episodes.Title: Gathering
Episodes.Description: As a charity event begins, the team prepares for the mission head of Sec. Barrios' arrival. Buth they might not be the only ones surveilling the area.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited
Episodes.Description: The team scrambles when an unexpected guest arrives but they continue to prioritize the target. Gabriela confronts a potentially compromised Tomas.

Episodes.Title: Party at High Noon
Episodes.Description: While Diego executes his group's plans, Max notifies her team about an unusual activity at the party. Greg and his former comrade corner Manuel at an unlikely place in an attempt to settle old scores.

Episodes.Title: Death is Calling
Episodes.Description: The mission grows complicated when Miguel mistakes a musician for a threat and Sec. Barrios veers off-program. Meanwhile, Greg confronts on an old friend.

Episodes.Title: In Plain Sight
Episodes.Description: Fearing for Ninong's life, Tomas follows the orders of an unknown caller. Max fills Greg in on the unexpected guest and Miguel's theory about the mix-up.

Episodes.Title: Panic Room
Episodes.Description: When an emergency occurs at the event, the team grows concerned when Tomas begins acting suspiciously, prompting Andres to tail him.

Episodes.Title: Puppeteer
Episodes.Description: Torn between completing the mission and protecting Tomas, the team decides to split up. Gabriela goes to help Ninong after Max gives her potential leads.

Episodes.Title: The Decision to Kill
Episodes.Description: As Gabriela continues to search for Ninong, the caller gives Tomas a shocking directive, Meanwhile, Max tells Greg about the snag mission.

Episodes.Title: Done For
Episodes.Description: The clock is ticking as Andres tries to stop the caller from pushing through with the plan, while Tomas moves to fulfill the final command.

Episodes.Title: Crossfire
Episodes.Description: A hallway shootout results in multiple casualties — and one hits close to home for Andres. Max, Tomas and Miguel rush to evacuate the area.

Episodes.Title: Devastation
Episodes.Description: As the team scrambles to get urgent medical care for the shootout victims, Miguel rushes to Andres' side while he anxiously waits for an update.

Episodes.Title: The Dead and the Dying
Episodes.Description: When Tomas mentions backing out of his job, he and Gabriela get some advice. Meanwhile, Miguel tries to support Andres through a difficult time.

Episodes.Title: Sudden Impact
Episodes.Description: While Andres confronts Manuel about the shootout, Tomas joins Gabriela to meet her father, but a surprise encounter with an armed man derails their plan.

Episodes.Title: What You Wish For
Episodes.Description: Greg arrives at Andres' home to pay respects, but meets resistance. Andres works to buy his family's land and JB seeks to keep his injuries a secret.

Episodes.Title: All Said and Done
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother urges him to let go of the past, while JB shares good news with his father. Missing his family, Miguel marks an important milestone.

Episodes.Title: Death on the Horizon
Episodes.Description: While Andres and his family celebrate with the community, Gabriela is caught off guard when she sees her father calling Tomas phone.

Episodes.Title: Fall Out
Episodes.Description: Tomas gets surprising news from Ninong, urging him to return home. A child delivers a suspicious package to Max's house as JB goes to pick up his father.

Episodes.Title: The Killing Time
Episodes.Description: After receiving news of a threat, the team realizes they might not be the only targets and frantically rush home to protect their loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Bloodshed
Episodes.Description: Manuel's plan swings into action, sending the team reeling. Noticing his silence, Andres' grandmother asks if he misses life in the city.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: While Greg and Miguel keep watch over a devastated Max, Gabriela tries to make amends with her father before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: No Turning Back
Episodes.Description: After an emotional update from Miguel about the state of the team following the Barrios mission, Andres agrees to meet with Greg.

Episodes.Title: Bullets
Episodes.Description: Greg calls in reinforcements as the team prepares to launch their attack on Manuel's potential stronghold while rescuing the children imprisoned there.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the strike, Greg and the team air out their grief and grievances as they come to terms with the cost of their mission.

Episodes.Title: Split
Episodes.Description: Andres and JB reconcile over their losses. After witnessing cruelty at the stronghold, Tomas and Gabriela wants to act, but Miguel urges caution.

Episodes.Title: We Move as a Team
Episodes.Description: The team carefully advances through the stronghold. But before they can attempt their strike, Andres must reach the kidnapped children.

Episodes.Title: Get Your Guns Out
Episodes.Description: Max lands in trouble when El Cano operatives swarm around her, while Andres' team discovers there are more children being held captive.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Caught in a perilous shoot-out, Gabriel and Tomas take a moment to make peace. Meanwhile, Andres attempts to honor a child's request.

Episodes.Title: This Time for Heroes
Episodes.Description: Greg and the gang try to lure Manuel and the rest of El Cano out with threats of gunfire. But when they're nowhere to be seen, the team gets suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Bad Time to Die
Episodes.Description: Danger continues as the team spots bomb traps in the buildings. Greg realizes the El Cano is using a sinister weapon for deadly attacks.

Episodes.Title: Kontraktwalistas
Episodes.Description: Andres and Tomas attempt to rescue a teammate in trouble as El Cano forces threaten to gun them down. JB's condition puts him and Max in a bind.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: As JB and Max try to escape El Cano operatives, they must fend off Manuel's right hand man. Meanwhile Miguel helps out Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Exit Point
Episodes.Description: While JB and Max continue the fight against Manuel's henchman, Greg confronts an old friend to finish the mission once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Love and Honor
Episodes.Description: As Greg vows to take down El Cano, Gabriela discuss their relationship, while Andres gets a visitor he wasn't expecting.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.
